label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Si su señor da a él mujer, y da a luz a él hijos o hijas, la mujer y sus hijos serán a su señor, y él saldrá en su soledad.
spanish: Si su señor le da mujer, y le da a luz hijos o hijas, la mujer y sus hijos será de su señor, y él saldrá solo.
grammarChanges: Replaced the calque 'a él' with the Spanish dative clitic 'le' in both clauses (same ל֣וֹ / ל֥וֹ beneficiary, no participant change).
Changed 'serán' to 'será' to match תִּהְיֶה, qal imperfect 3fs, which treats 'la mujer' as the grammatical head of the compound subject rather than smoothing to a plural compound.
Replaced 'a' with 'de' after 'ser' ('será de su señor') to use the idiomatic Spanish construction for belonging instead of the literal calque of ל, with the same governed noun 'su señor'.
Replaced 'en su soledad' (solitude) with 'solo' to render בְגַפּוֹ, 'with/by his own body' i.e. 'by himself', as the adjective it is rather than an abstract noun it is not.
readerNote: Kept the verb singular ('será') to mirror the Hebrew's 3fs form, which grammatically heads the compound subject on 'la mujer' alone even though 'sus hijos' follows.
